### 2026-10-09 – It's October 9th and I just took on this Half Life project form Hack Club.

**4.5h**

It's October 9th and I just took on this Half Life project form Hack Club.
Everything is a little overwhelming for me since I've never worked with electronics at this level before but I am happy to be participating!

I am following the Starbie/Week 1 guide and I am trying my best to follow along, I did watch a few setup tutorials on youtube for  kicad but I got to the bottom of it in no time!

### 2026-10-10 – October 10th, I'm working on starbie some more!

**7h**

October 10th, I'm working on starbie some more!
I accidentally hit discard on my journal entry a moment before finishing it...oh well.
I started work at 11AM but got terribly stuck on footprint assignment for my components and gave up around 12AM.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-10 12-34-38](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/1317e29e3d623e2e717b61e067811c5b012ca55a4347643e0990e1c68db0f6b9.png)

### 2026-10-11 – I spent the better part of my morning thinkering away with my design and finnaly got the ground fill working after a few tutorials and some real trial and error.

**5h**

I spent the better part of my morning thinkering away with my design and finnaly got the ground fill working after a few tutorials and some real trial and error.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-11 17-50-37](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/f342f2f84f1bdc7ddaac9fa956447f0601b457f061a6784f281eb3dcd105308d.png)

Isn't it beautiful? I'm so proud of myself for getting this far!
For a total newbie. I feel like I actually accomplished something

FOUND AN ISSUE. after I set up that in fill for ground my 3.3V lines vanished, so I had to hook them up again and to redo the in fill so the ground and 3.3V dont short out.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-11 17-55-46](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/583f5d7b64dab7422059cdf0fad2af5cd799e93b08aea90119f21bafb9b9ec0a.png)

![Screenshot From 2026-10-11 18-11-24](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/dd28b80a284b10d2d074e5be6ce9613f71d24cf932983030cbc84e9b0d7cbf91.png)
Only two errors and I think they don't really matter all that much, and the same goes for the 20 warnings.
